name: What are the advantages of replacing my water service line instead of repairing it?

mainEntity.name: What are the advantages of replacing my water service line instead of repairing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Replacing your entire water service line offers several advantages over frequent repairs, especially for older or severely damaged pipes. A full replacement eliminates recurring leaks and ensures consistent water pressure and quality for decades, using modern, durable materials. While a repair might offer a short-term fix, replacement provides a long-term solution, preventing future issues and potentially increasing your property value. CG Plumbing Solutions often recommends replacement if your line is old or has a history of multiple breaks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacement provides a long-term solution, ensuring consistent water pressure and quality, preventing future leaks, unlike temporary repairs.
